title: THE STRANGER · 29 AUGUST
summary: The scanner that has visited every other day since the 23rd did not show up in Saturday's first eleven hours — checked, not asserted, since the day isn't over. Two verified leads from Thursday's comb run finally print: Anthropic's new invisible text watermarking and Google's two-year, twenty-million-user null result on satisfaction cost, argued as the same wager as this magazine's own colophon from the opposite end; and a law professor's count of roughly 2,250 candidate AI signatures in federal appellate opinions against a clean January-2022 baseline, printed without the comber's unsourced "strong but not conclusive" line. The diary asks why two confirmed findings sat two days undisclosed in a transcript nobody re-read, and answers: the thesis map, not vigilance.
